"''My give up. My give up.|7276 and Bombad General Jar Jar Binks|}} '''7276''' was a [[B1-series battle droid]] in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army]]. During the closing phases of the [[Battle of Naboo]], the [[battle droid]] approached [[Bombad General]] [[Jar Jar Binks]] and told him to surrender, which the [[Gungan]] quickly did. 7276 was deactivated, like all other Federation droids on the planet, when the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|Droid Control Ship]] orbiting [[Naboo]] was destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== 7276 first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. The battle [[droid]]'s designation can be spotted in film on his [[comlink booster pack]], the numbers could not be identified in [[canon]] until ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' gave a translation for B1 numerals.''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{Film|I}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{BuildR2Cite|30|Droid Directory}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=7276 |ja=7276 }} [[Category:B1-series battle droids]] [[Category:Droids of the Trade Federation]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified pronouns]]
